info.title: convt API
info.description: Paid conversions at 1 cent per successful job; failed and cancelled jobs are free. POST /v1/convert takes a file of up to 25 MB (or a source_url) and answers with the converted file in one request. For larger files, reserve a job with POST /v1/jobs, PUT exactly input_bytes to upload_url (the signature binds Content-Length), then POST start, poll and download every output. Send an Idempotency-Key on creates so retries never reserve twice. Jobs and their files expire after 24 hours. Each account may retain at most 100 job prefixes and 50 GB of declared input storage. 120 requests per minute per key; every response carries X-RateLimit-* headers and an X-Request-Id. Jobs created with webhook_url get one signed POST when they finish.

post.summary: Reserve a conversion and get a 15-minute upload URL

input_format.description: Required unless source_url ends in a known extension.

input_bytes.description: Exact upload size. Required unless source_url is set.

get.summary: Read the status of an owned job

post.summary: Seal the upload, validate its actual size and queue the job
Cancel an owned job and release its reservation

get.summary: Get signed download URLs for completed outputs

post.summary: Convert a file in one request

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Target format id or extension. Required here or as a form field.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Input format id or extension. Inferred from the file name, source_url or Content-Type when left out.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Name of a raw-body upload, used to infer `from` and name the result.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Conversion settings as URL-encoded JSON, such as `{"quality":80}`.

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Seconds to wait for the result, 0 to 300. Default 120. When it runs out: `202` if you sent `Accept: application/json` (the job keeps running), `409 still_running` for a file request with an `Idempotency-Key` (the job keeps running), or `504 timeout` for a file request without one (the job is cancelled).

schema.description: The raw file, up to 25 MB. Pass `to` (and `from` or `filename`) in the query.

200.description: The converted file, when the job produced one output and `Accept` does not ask for JSON. With several outputs or `Accept: application/json`, JSON with signed URLs.

202.description: Sent only with `Accept: application/json`: the job is still running after `wait` seconds. It keeps running and is billed if it succeeds; poll `Location`.

bearerAuth.description: cvt_live_ API key. Browser converters use a 5-minute account-scoped cvt_web_ credential issued by the site Worker.

job.description: The job the failed request created or touched, when there is one.

target_size.description: Largest output file in bytes. Lowers quality, and image size, to fit.

strip_metadata.description: Leave EXIF, GPS and other metadata out of the output.

trim_start.description: Start video or audio output here: seconds (12.5) or a timestamp ("1:30").

trim_end.description: End video or audio output here: seconds (12.5) or a timestamp ("1:30").

fps.description: Frames per second for video and GIF output.

X-Request-Id.description: Identifies this request. Quote it when you contact support. A plain id you send (up to 128 letters, digits, `-`, `_`, `.`) is echoed back.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests allowed per minute for this key.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current minute.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Seconds until the current minute's window resets.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: `true` when an Idempotency-Key matched an earlier request and no new job was reserved.

Convt-Job-Id.description: The job that served this conversion.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Any string of 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters, such as a UUID. Retrying with the same key and the same request returns the original job instead of reserving a new one, for 24 hours. The same key with a different request fails with `409 idempotency_key_reused`.
